---
title: "GLM Model Selection"
output: html_document
---

Use AIC and likelihood ratio tests to compare the main-effects model with interaction extensions.

```{r setup}
root <- if (dir.exists("R")) "." else ".."
source(file.path(root, "R/preprocessing.R"))
source(file.path(root, "R/modeling.R"))
d <- prepare_flights(read.csv(file.path(root, "data/raw/flight_data_2024_sample_200k.csv")))$model
fit <- fit_models(d)
```

```{r comparison}
summary(fit$main)
AIC(fit$main, fit$stepwise)
car::vif(fit$main)
fit$comparison[order(fit$comparison$aic), ]
anova(fit$main, fit$final, test = "Chisq")
summary(fit$final)
```
